audit_metadata.title: MAP2 AVB Router / Digital Patch System Verification Audit
audit_metadata.methodology: Deterministic source-code analysis against touring-grade AVB requirements

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: app/services/avb/avb_router.py: AvbRouter class with connect()/disconnect() supporting both MAP2-to-MAP2 and AVDECC ACMP. juce-engine/Source/AvdeccEntity.h: connectStream()/disconnectStream() with full ACMP PDU implementation. app/routes/avb.py: POST /api/avb/router/connect and /router/disconnect endpoints.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Full AVDECC ACMP implementation with ADP discovery, AECP enumeration, and ACMP connection management. Phase 11 added proper stream connection lifecycle. TUI shows streams but does not expose connect/disconnect controls. Web UI has no AVB components.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: app/services/avb/avb_router.py:742-763 get_routing_matrix() returns Dict[talker_id, Dict[listener_id, ConnectionState]]. app/routes/avb.py:921-962 GET /api/avb/router/matrix endpoint.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Routing matrix data structure exists and is exposed via REST API. No TUI or web UI rendering of the matrix grid.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: juce-engine/Source/AvdeccEntity.h:47 defines ADP_MULTICAST_MAC and ACMP_MULTICAST_MAC. AvbStream.h uses configurable destMac supporting multicast MACs. avb_router.py:614 defaults to multicast '91:e0:f0:00:fe:01'.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Multicast addressing is supported at the stream level, but there is no explicit replication/fanout manager. A single talker can be connected to multiple listeners via separate connect() calls, which achieves multicast replication at the connection management level. No visibility into multicast group membership or IGMP/MLD integration.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No code implementing unicast-to-multicast or multicast-to-unicast translation found in any source file.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: AVB/TSN natively uses multicast (IEEE 1722). Unicast fallback/translation is not standard AVB behavior but may be needed for hybrid deployments. Not implemented.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No stream aggregation (combining multiple low-channel streams into one high-channel stream) found in any source file.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Individual streams are managed independently. No multiplexing of multiple source streams into a single aggregate stream.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No stream de-aggregation (splitting a high-channel stream into multiple lower-channel streams) found in any source file.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Not implemented. Would require channel mapping layer between AVTP frames and audio engine.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: juce-engine/Source/AvdeccEntity.h:204 AcmpPdu has stream_vlan_id field. app/services/avb/tsn_qdisc.py:134-135 checks for VLAN interface (interface.2). scripts/setup_avb_qdiscs.sh likely configures VLAN 2.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: VLAN 2 (standard AVB SR Class A VLAN) is configured at the system level. Per-stream VLAN assignment is carried in ACMP PDUs but there is no dynamic per-stream VLAN configuration API. TUI shows VLAN configured status.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No MSRP (Multiple Stream Registration Protocol) or SRP (Stream Reservation Protocol) implementation found. No bandwidth reservation or admission control logic.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: SRP/MSRP is a critical AVB protocol for bandwidth reservation. The system relies on manual CBS configuration via tc qdiscs rather than dynamic SRP. This is a significant gap for touring-grade deployment.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: avb_router.py connect()/disconnect() operate on individual connections without disrupting other active connections. ConnectionState tracks CONNECTING/CONNECTED/DISCONNECTING states. Rollback on failure at line 638.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Individual stream connections can be added/removed without disrupting others. However, there is no hitless crossfade mechanism - the disconnect and reconnect are separate operations. No glitch-free transition guarantee during reroute.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: juce-engine/Source/SnapshotManager.h: saveSnapshot()/loadSnapshot() with 6 slots (0-5). app/routes/snapshots.py and app/routes/flow_snapshots.py exist. However, snapshots are for the plugin chain only - not for AVB routing state.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Audio processing chain snapshots exist but AVB routing matrix snapshots do not. A routing snapshot system would need to serialize all StreamConnection states and restore them on recall.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No version control or history tracking for routing changes found in any source file.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Not implemented. Would need an event log with timestamps tracking all connect/disconnect operations with undo capability.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No time-based or schedule-based routing change mechanism found.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Not implemented. Would require a scheduler that triggers connect/disconnect at specified times or cue points.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No graph visualization component found in web/src/ or TUI. The routing matrix API endpoint exists (GET /api/avb/router/matrix) but no visual rendering.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Data layer exists but no visualization layer. Web UI has no AVB-related React components.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No crossfade or morphing mechanism for routing transitions found.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Not implemented. Would require mixing/crossfading engine at the stream connection level.

routing_and_stream_engine.evidence: No routing template or preset system for AVB connections found.
routing_and_stream_engine.notes: Not implemented. Would need template serialization format and template instantiation logic.

clock_and_timing.evidence: app/services/avb/ptp_monitor.py: PTPMonitor wraps ptp4l (linuxptp) via pmc CLI and journalctl parsing. scripts/setup_avb_ptp.sh configures ptp4l. AvdeccEntity.h:239 stores gptp_grandmaster_id and domain.
clock_and_timing.notes: MAP2 delegates gPTP to ptp4l (linuxptp) which is the reference IEEE 802.1AS implementation. MAP2 monitors ptp4l status but does not implement 802.1AS itself. This is architecturally correct (ptp4l is kernel-integrated). PTPStatus exposes state, offset, delay, grandmaster ID. TUI shows PTP status with color-coded offset.

clock_and_timing.evidence: Dependent on ptp4l configuration. ptp4l supports boundary clock mode via /etc/ptp4l.conf 'clockType' parameter. No MAP2-specific boundary clock configuration or monitoring.
clock_and_timing.notes: ptp4l supports boundary clock mode but MAP2 does not expose configuration or monitoring for it.

clock_and_timing.evidence: No transparent clock configuration or support found. ptp4l does not support TC mode natively.
clock_and_timing.notes: Transparent clock is a switch-level feature, not an endpoint feature. Not applicable for end-station software.

clock_and_timing.evidence: app/routes/avb.py:171 exposes 'ptp_priority1' in config (config_get('avb.ptp_priority1', 128)). ptp_monitor.py:28 tracks grandmaster_priority1. No API to dynamically change priority.
clock_and_timing.notes: Priority is readable via API but only configurable via static config (avb.ptp_priority1). No live adjustment API.

clock_and_timing.evidence: ptp4l handles BMCA (Best Master Clock Algorithm) automatically, including failover to next-best grandmaster. MAP2 monitors state transitions (MASTER->SLAVE etc). No explicit failover logic in MAP2 code.
clock_and_timing.notes: ptp4l handles clock failover natively via BMCA. MAP2 can detect state changes but does not implement additional failover logic beyond what ptp4l provides.

clock_and_timing.evidence: No multi-domain clock bridging found. Only domain 0 support evident.
clock_and_timing.notes: Not implemented. Would require multiple ptp4l instances and domain-to-domain time translation.

clock_and_timing.evidence: ptp_monitor.py:52-99 get_status() returns offset_ns (clock drift from grandmaster). Periodic monitoring at configurable intervals (default 1s). PTPStatus.offset_ns updated continuously.
clock_and_timing.notes: Drift is monitored via ptp4l offset. TUI color-codes offset: green (<100ns), yellow (<500ns), red (>500ns).

clock_and_timing.evidence: ptp_monitor.py: PTPStatus exposes offset_ns and mean_path_delay_ns. pmc queries CURRENT_DATA_SET (offsetFromMaster) and PARENT_DATA_SET (grandmaster info). Journalctl fallback parsing.
clock_and_timing.notes: Full diagnostic data available: offset, path delay, grandmaster identity, priority, clock class.

clock_and_timing.evidence: juce-engine/Source/AvbStream.h:65-66 tracks timestampErrors and sequenceErrors atomically. AvbStreamStats exposes these counters. No active integrity verification with alerting.
clock_and_timing.notes: Error counters exist for timestamp and sequence errors but no active alerting or integrity verification protocol.

bandwidth_and_determinism.evidence: No SRP/MSRP implementation. No admission logging.

app/services/avb/tsn_qdisc.py:118-124 monitors CBS idleslope/sendslope. tsn_qdisc.py:234-286 calculate_cbs_parameters() computes required bandwidth. Queue stats (sent_bytes, dropped, overlimits) tracked per qdisc.
bandwidth_and_determinism.notes: CBS bandwidth is monitored via tc qdisc stats. No distinction between Class A and Class B traffic classes. No real-time utilization percentage calculation.

bandwidth_and_determinism.evidence: AvbStreamConfig.presentationOffsetUs provides deterministic presentation time. AvbStreamStats tracks maxLatencyNs/minLatencyNs. tsn_qdisc.py calculate_cbs_parameters() computes bandwidth requirements.
bandwidth_and_determinism.notes: Latency is measured empirically (max/min) but not calculated deterministically from topology. No worst-case latency bounds computation.

bandwidth_and_determinism.evidence: No congestion prediction or early warning system found.
bandwidth_and_determinism.notes: Not implemented. Would need trend analysis on queue depth and drop rates.

bandwidth_and_determinism.evidence: No simulation or dry-run mode for testing routing configurations found.

tsn_qdisc.py TsnStatus exposes cbs_configured, cbs_idleslope, cbs_sendslope. TsnQdiscManager.calculate_cbs_parameters() provides CBS parameter computation. Queue stats per qdisc handle. TUI TsnStatusWidget shows CBS parameters.
bandwidth_and_determinism.notes: CBS configuration and parameters are fully visible. REST API at GET /api/avb/tsn/status and GET /api/avb/tsn/calculate_cbs.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: No dual-NIC or network redundancy configuration found. Single interface support only (avb.interface config key).
reliability_and_touring.notes: Critical gap for touring-grade deployment. Milan specifies redundancy. Not implemented.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: No LACP or link aggregation configuration found.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Not implemented. Could be handled at OS level with bonding driver but not integrated into MAP2.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: No automatic failover routing found. Connection failures are logged but not automatically retried or rerouted.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Not implemented. Would require topology awareness and alternative path computation.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: AvbStreamStats tracks 11 metrics atomically (framesSent, errors, underruns, overruns, timestampErrors, sequenceErrors, latency). avb_service.py get_stream_stats() exposes these. No composite health score.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Raw metrics available but no composite OK/WARN/CRITICAL health scoring algorithm.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: AvbStream.h AvbStreamStats: sequenceErrors (out-of-order/missing), sendErrors, receiveErrors, timestampErrors. All atomic for lock-free access. tsn_qdisc.py QdiscStats.dropped tracks kernel-level drops.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Packet loss is detectable via sequence error counters and qdisc drop counters. No alerting threshold.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: Python logging throughout avb_router.py, avb_service.py, ptp_monitor.py. Error states logged with logger.error(). Connection state changes logged. No structured audit trail or event log database.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Standard logging exists. TUI has log viewer tab. No persistent structured event log for audit purposes.

reliability_and_touring.evidence: tsn_qdisc.py monitors NIC queue stats. ptp_monitor.py monitors PTP hardware. Node Console shows CPU, audio device detection. No NIC temperature, link status, or SFP monitoring.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Basic hardware monitoring via existing subsystems. No deep NIC telemetry (ethtool stats, link partner capabilities, PHY diagnostics).

reliability_and_touring.evidence: No redundant clock validation or multi-source clock comparison found.
reliability_and_touring.notes: Not implemented. Would need multiple clock sources and cross-validation logic.

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: AudioEndpoint dataclass has device_name, format, channels, sample_rate. AvbCapabilities has TXT record fields. No arbitrary user-defined metadata tagging.
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: Fixed metadata fields exist. No user-defined tags or labels.

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: No authentication or authorization on AVB API endpoints.
No multi-user session tracking or conflict resolution found.

app/routes/avb.py: Comprehensive FastAPI router with 25+ endpoints covering PTP, TSN, streams, discovery, AVDECC entities, routing matrix, connections, entity models, and cache stats. Full CRUD for streams. OpenAPI docs at /docs.
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: Excellent REST API coverage. All AVB subsystems exposed with consistent error handling and graceful degradation.

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: REST API supports filtering (e.g., GET /router/endpoints?direction=talker). Routing matrix returns structured Dict[talker, Dict[listener, state]].
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: Basic query filtering exists. No advanced query language (GraphQL, custom DSL).

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: ~/.map2/config.json is human-readable JSON. SnapshotManager saves to file. No AVB routing config export/import.
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: General config is exportable. AVB routing state is not serializable to file.

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: docs/avb-setup.md, docs/MAP2_Educational_Overview_2026-02-14.md, docs/AVDECC_FUTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md exist. Code has docstrings. No inline TUI/UI help popups.
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: Documentation files exist but no inline educational explanations in TUI or Web UI.

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: AvbDiscoveryService discovers nodes via mDNS. Discovered nodes are listed with IP, capabilities. No graphical topology map generation.
nice_to_have_advanced.notes: Device discovery works. No topology visualization (link-level map of switches, endpoints, etc.).

nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: No AI or heuristic routing recommendation engine found.

nice_to_have_advanced.requirement_description: Quick-build wizards (FOH, festival, immersive, studio, rehearsal)
nice_to_have_advanced.evidence: No deployment wizard or template instantiation system found.

tui_requirements.evidence: tui/screens/avb_tab.py: StreamsTable shows streams, DiscoveryTable shows nodes. No routing matrix grid widget or connect/disconnect controls.
tui_requirements.notes: TUI shows status/streams/discovery but has no interactive routing matrix.

tui_requirements.evidence: tui/screens/avb_tab.py:190-226 StreamsTable with columns: Stream ID, Direction, State, Channels, Sample Rate. Color-coded states. Auto-updates every 5 seconds via update_loop().
tui_requirements.notes: Stream state table with color-coded status and auto-refresh.

tui_requirements.evidence: tui/screens/avb_tab.py:74-122 PtpStatusWidget shows: State, Offset (color-coded), Path Delay, Grandmaster ID. Uses green/yellow/red thresholds (100ns/500ns).
tui_requirements.notes: Full PTP status with visual health indicators.

tui_requirements.evidence: tui/screens/avb_tab.py:124-175 TsnStatusWidget shows: mqprio, CBS, ETF, VLAN status with checkmarks/crosses. CBS idleslope in Mbps.
tui_requirements.notes: TSN qdisc configuration and CBS bandwidth visible.

tui_requirements.evidence: No redundancy status widget in TUI. No dual-network support.
tui_requirements.notes: Not applicable since T-01 (dual-network) is not implemented.

tui_requirements.evidence: No AVB routing snapshot control in TUI. Audio chain snapshots exist but not in AVB tab.
No inline help in AVB tab. Node Console has Help tab but not AVB-specific.

avb_tab.py: PTP offset green/yellow/red at 100/500ns thresholds. Stream state: green=running, yellow=starting/stopping, dim=stopped, red=error. avb_status_widget.py: Border colors green=healthy, yellow=partial, red=degraded.
tui_requirements.notes: Comprehensive color-coding across all AVB widgets.

webui_requirements.evidence: No AVB-related React components found in web/src/. Glob for *avb*, *routing*, *stream* in web/src/ returned no matches.
webui_requirements.notes: Web UI has zero AVB components. It is a pedalboard editor only.

webui_requirements.evidence: No PTP/clock visualization in web UI.
No bandwidth visualization in web UI.
No stream health dashboard in web UI.
No configuration timeline in web UI.
No deployment wizards in web UI.
No AVB log viewer in web UI. TUI has log viewer.
webui_requirements.notes: Not implemented in web. TUI has it.

webui_requirements.evidence: No educational content in web UI.

stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.evidence: avb_status_widget.py uses Healthy/Partial/Degraded with green/yellow/red borders. PTP offset thresholds. Stream state color coding. No unified OK/WARN/CRITICAL enum across all subsystems.
stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.notes: Individual widgets have health indicators but no unified system-wide health status.

stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.evidence: avb_service.py StreamState.ERROR stores error string. PTPStatus.error explains unavailability. avb_router.py ConnectionState.ERROR with error_message. avb/__init__.py is_avb_available() provides specific failure reasons.
stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.notes: Good error messaging throughout. Specific reasons provided for all failure modes.

stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.evidence: Error messages describe what failed but do not suggest remediation steps.
stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.notes: No remediation suggestions. e.g., 'ptp4l not running' should suggest 'systemctl start map2-ptp4l'.

stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.evidence: Python logging captures all events. journalctl preserves history. No structured event database for querying.
stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.notes: Events are logged to systemd journal but no queryable event store.

stage_3_diagnostic_mandate.evidence: All REST API endpoints return JSON. PTPStatus.to_dict(), TsnStatus.to_dict(), AvbNode.to_dict(), stream_to_dict() all produce serializable JSON.

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: docs/AVB_SIGNAL_FLOW_SPEC.json, docs/AVB_SIGNAL_FLOW_COMPARISON.md, docs/AVDECC_FUTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md, docs/MAP2_AVB_Capabilities_and_Usecases_2026-02-14.md. Code-level docstrings in all Python and C++ headers.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: Architecture documented at high level. No detailed design decision rationale (why AVTP AAF over CRF, why AF_PACKET over XDP, etc.).

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: AvdeccEntity.h references IEEE 1722.1. AvbStream.h references IEEE 1722 AVTP AAF. ptp_monitor.py references IEEE 802.1AS. No formal citation format.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: IEEE standard references in code comments. No bibliography or formal citations.

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: No FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) document found.
AvbRingBuffer.h documents lock-free SPSC design. AvbStream.h documents RT-safety. AvbAudioIODevice.h documents thread architecture. No end-to-end determinism analysis.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: Component-level determinism documented. No system-level worst-case analysis.

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: No state diagrams (visual) found. StreamState and ConnectionState enums define states textually.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: State enums exist but no visual state machine diagrams.

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: C++ headers have detailed Doxygen-style comments. Python has comprehensive docstrings. FastAPI endpoints have description strings. No formal interface specification document.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: Code-level documentation is good. No separate interface contract document.

stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: 8 test files: test_avb_integration.py, test_avb_rt_safety.py, test_avb_discovery_service.py, test_avb_router_map2.py, test_avb_router_factory.py, test_avb_stream_validation.py, test_avb_service_stats.py, test_avb_service_engine_contract.py. Tests exist but test documentation/rationale not captured.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: Good test coverage. No test plan document or test rationale documentation.

stage_4_documentation_verification.requirement_description: Educational appendix (gPTP, SRP, AVTP, CBS, deterministic L2)
stage_4_documentation_verification.evidence: docs/MAP2_Educational_Overview_2026-02-14.md exists. docs/avb-setup.md covers setup. Code comments reference standards. No comprehensive educational appendix covering all listed protocols.
stage_4_documentation_verification.notes: Some educational content exists. No dedicated appendix covering gPTP, SRP, AVTP, CBS, and deterministic L2 transport as specified.

stage_5_touring_validation_tests.evidence: No dual-network redundancy implemented. No failure simulation test.
stage_5_touring_validation_tests.notes: Cannot test what is not implemented (T-01).

stage_5_touring_validation_tests.evidence: No clock failure simulation test. ptp4l handles BMCA failover but no MAP2 test exercises it.
No bandwidth stress test found in tests/.
No live rerouting test found. test_avb_router_map2.py tests routing but not during active streaming.
No large-scale simulation test found. MAX_CHANNELS=8 in AvbAudioIODevice.h suggests current design targets small channel counts.
stage_5_touring_validation_tests.notes: Not tested. Current design supports max 8 channels per stream, not 200+ total channels across all streams.

stage_1_summary.stage_summary: Feature completeness is strong in core AVB transport (AVTP, gPTP monitoring, AVDECC) but weak in touring-grade features (redundancy, SRP, scheduling, visualization)

stage_2_summary.stage_summary: TUI has decent AVB monitoring. Web UI has ZERO AVB support.

stage_3_summary.stage_summary: Machine-readable output is excellent. Remediation suggestions missing.

stage_4_summary.stage_summary: Code documentation is good. Formal documentation artifacts (FMEA, state diagrams, educational appendix) are missing.

overall_completion.verdict: INCOMPLETE - Significant gaps in touring-grade features, web UI, and validation testing

architecture_strengths: Clean separation: C++ RT engine (AvbStream, AvbRingBuffer) + Python management layer (AvbService, AvbRouter)
Lock-free SPSC ring buffer with cache-line alignment for RT-safe audio transport
Comprehensive AVDECC implementation: ADP discovery, ACMP connection management, AECP entity enumeration
Atomic statistics counters for lock-free stream health monitoring
Graceful degradation: all services return available=false when hardware absent
REST API with 25+ endpoints and OpenAPI documentation
ptp4l delegation (correct architectural choice - uses reference 802.1AS implementation)
TSN qdisc management with CBS parameter calculation
8 unit test files covering routing, discovery, stream validation, RT safety, and engine contracts
critical_gaps_for_touring_grade: SRP/MSRP not implemented - no bandwidth reservation protocol
No web UI for AVB (zero React components)
No automatic failover routing on link/device failure
MAX_CHANNELS=8 per stream - insufficient for large deployments
No routing snapshots (only audio chain snapshots)
No FMEA or failure mode documentation

resumption_instructions.stage_summary: Audit complete. Implementation needed for 31 FAIL items.
next_required_actions: 1. CRITICAL: Implement SRP/MSRP admission control (R-08, B-01) - required for standards compliance
2. CRITICAL: Implement dual-network redundancy (T-01) - required for touring reliability
3. HIGH: Build Web UI AVB components (UI-W-01 through UI-W-09) - required for usability
4. HIGH: Add interactive routing matrix to TUI (UI-T-01) with connect/disconnect controls
5. HIGH: Implement routing snapshot save/recall (R-10 upgrade, UI-T-06)
7. MEDIUM: Implement automatic reroute on failure (T-03)
8. MEDIUM: Add routing graph visualization (R-13) using d3.js (already a dependency)
9. MEDIUM: Write touring validation tests (TV-01 through TV-06)
10. MEDIUM: Create FMEA document (DOC-03) and state diagrams (DOC-05)
12. LOW: Implement wizards (N-11), templates (R-15), and sandbox mode (N-07)
resumption_instructions.resumption_context: The MAP2 codebase has a solid AVB foundation with C++ AVTP streaming, Python management layer, and comprehensive REST API. The critical path to touring-grade is: SRP -> redundancy -> web UI -> validation tests. Key files: app/services/avb/ (Python services), juce-engine/Source/Avb*.h/cpp (C++ engine), app/routes/avb.py (REST API), tui/screens/avb_tab.py (TUI).
